# Once v0.1.1

Changes since v0.1.0, grouped by platform.

## Across all platforms

- **Reader** now renders article documents inside an isolated iframe (`srcdoc`)
  instead of blob URLs, improving styling and script isolation.
- **More resilient startup** — persisted stories are shown even when a story
  source fails to load, and startup story loading is faster and steadier.
- **Safer story storage** — writes are serialized per URL with snapshot saves and
  guards against stale change-feed echoes, plus tools to recover corrupted stories.
- **Text-to-speech** gained a fallback/replacement voice path in the reader.
- Settings renamed "source" to "story source", and the story list now supports
  pull-to-refresh.
- Expanded application error diagnostics.

## Electron (desktop)

- Fixed macOS window-control overlap and the title-bar overlay hiding the tabs
  and the "+" button.
- Fixed a macOS window drag issue.
- Tab mute icon now stays visible.
- Allow running multiple portable Once instances in parallel.
- Packaging force-kills a blocking process so builds no longer stall.

## Mobile (Android & iOS)

- Major work on the Capacitor apps for Android and iOS.
- Restyled the mobile UI and fixed Android story swiping via the action sheet.
- Fixed opening links on iOS and replaced the default Capacitor icon on Android.
- Substantial mobile end-to-end and CI test infrastructure (Appium, iOS
  simulator, WebDriverAgent, remote ADB).

## Extensions (Firefox & Chrome)

- Pick up all of the shared reader, storage, and UI improvements above.
- Test fixes for Firefox 153.
